definitions.measure: E136's MEASURES['strength'] (strength by odor: kcq/population_fit.py's parts strength/rate and strength/mean, each odor's entry relative to the panel's mean, the view's error the RMS of the two parts' errors in one-fly units); the guard every view (E136's error_column: the PN dendrites on four)
definitions.value: the mean over the T wirings of each wiring's error; the megamat stage error per wiring the RMS of its four stages' errors
definitions.reading: each run once: stage_readings.read_run with E134's default readings against all the stage's (or panel's) flies (E136's Flies(None) for megamat, a FlyCache for the held-out panels), seed index E136's seed_index(wiring); the parts reference_views against all the flies' reference
definitions.reference: a subset or resample: the weighted mean of the flies' parts (NaN-aware), in all the flies' one-fly units (kcq/population_fit.py's subset_reference(keep_units=True))

check.against: E136's classes.json (measure strength): the megamat 'arm' value on T against the held-out half

definitions.consistency: Spearman ρ over the settings (role 'setting') of their values against half a and half b
definitions.bar: IMPROVE_SE = 2 standard errors by E136's compare (se the larger of half the spread and the SD of the per-wiring changes over T over sqrt(4)); spreads as scored in the class tables

flag.statistic: response rate ρ, APL on, against the control recordings in baseline-noise units

classes.tells_apart: "A stage tells the saved models apart": consistency over the settings is 0.8 or more at the median split and 0.5 or more on every split
classes.reads_calyx: "Megamat reads the calyx": the same over the nine settings at pn_inhadd 1000, at the claws and at the somata
classes.change_stands: "A change stands through the flies": its interval excludes zero; on megamat it is also beyond the bar against both halves on at least 80% of the joint splits
classes.class_stands: "A class stands through the flies": the scored class is read on at least 80% of the resamples
classes.count: "The count's": on at least two of the three panels with many flies, halves of 2 give consistency under 0.5 and the largest halves read give 0.8 or more
classes.panel: "The panel's": halves of 2 already give 0.8 or more there (on at least two of the three)
classes.fifth_fly: the fifth fly is a description, never a class: it is one fly

outcomes.a: megamat tells models apart at the PN stages only, and does not read the calyx
outcomes.b: all four stages tell models apart
outcomes.c: A1's megamat fall or its "holds" does not stand through the flies
outcomes.d: near-tie classes change with the flies (at least one changes on more than a fifth of the resamples)

narrow_readings: the measure is E136's adopted one, strength by odor (E136's MEASURES['strength']); the PN dendrites read on it with E136's error column ('error', not the matrix view); E136's rule-3 guard reads every view (four at the PN dendrites) and is recomputed on each resample where a class reads it

only the T wirings are read: every value is the mean over T, and every spread is the one scored (the family over its eight wirings, from the class tables); the fitted arms' S wirings (their fits' best evaluations) are not read

E135's fitted (R1, R3) and imposed (from the trial-noise and the dF/F dendrites) arms are settings; their five permuted controls are yardsticks only (scored and reported, in no consistency and no class); consistency over the settings without E135's four is given beside, since their PN stages were set from the dendrite flies

a split's halves: 'a' the smaller half (floor(n / 2) flies, E136's fit-half size), 'b' the rest; for a 2 / 2 split 'a' the half with the stage's first fly, so each division is counted once; E136's own split is split_halves(n, 1, 0) as E136's split_names takes it

the joint splits: JOINT_SEED draws N_JOINT distinct combinations (np.random.default_rng(JOINT_SEED).choice without replacement over the product of the four stages' splits, in stage order), and E136's own split beside them

consistency is Spearman ρ (scipy's, ties averaged) over the settings' values (the mean over T of each wiring's error) against the two halves, in all the stage's flies' one-fly units; the median over a stage's splits decides "tells apart"

beyond E136's bar against a half: the change (mean over T of the per-wiring changes) has the sign of the change as scored (the class table's, else against E136's held-out half) and exceeds IMPROVE_SE standard errors by E136's rule (compare: the larger of half the spread as scored and the SD of the per-wiring changes over T over 2)

the resamples: each stage's and each panel's flies drawn with replacement, as many as the stage or panel has, every stage and panel drawn independently on the same resample index (one generator, BOOT_SEED, stages in LOSS_STAGES order then the panels in HOLDS_PANELS + BESIDE_PANELS order); the reference is the drawn flies' mean view, in all the flies' one-fly units

a class recomputed on a resample: E136's classify ladder on the resampled values with every comparison's spread and bar (IMPROVE_SE standard errors) as scored in the class table, the permuted control's fall as scored, and the class table's reasons that do not depend on the flies (a bound, a realism band, a failed hold, reads stopped) kept; E141's added classes (stands in, does more than A1) recomputed the same way against A1
the class against all the flies, unresampled, is given beside each share

the changes minus another setting are E141's comparisons with A1 (against_a1: its megamat stage error and the held-out panels); the class tables' names map to the settings: 'A1' is E136's A1, E139's names E139's reads (E141's B_inhadd1000 and K_inhadd1000 among them), E141's names its reads

fit evaluations beside (FIT_EVALS_BESIDE): every saved evaluation of E136's fits whose stages this host holds (hal: A3's), read once on S as the settings are on T, their consistency on every split given beside as a description (E136's own read 483 evaluations of all fits on one split); they enter no class

item 5: the control mixtures have 4 flies as E136 reads them (the entry's 11 is the two mixture panels' KC flies together), so the third panel with many flies is the kiwi mixtures (7 flies; MANY_FLY_PANELS), and the classes on the entry's three (MANY_FLY_PANELS_AS_NAMED, the control mixtures at halves of 2 only) are given beside
item 5 beside: megamat's four stages read the same way at the half sizes they allow (halves of 2 at the claws and somata are their three splits)

item 5: disjoint halves of k flies drawn N_COUNT_DRAWS times (seed COUNT_SEED, each draw a permutation of the panel's flies, its first k one half and its next k the other); consistency over the settings read on that panel; "halves of 2" and "the largest halves" read at the median over draws

the fifth fly: each setting's somata strength error against the same-fly recording's somata alone (its parts the reference's mean), in the four soma flies' one-fly units, beside each of the four against the other three and each setting against the four; the claw fly 2023-04-11 fly03 against its second acquisition likewise

item 7: E136's stage_without_odor rule (E138's odor_entries: aa's term taken out of the squared error, the number of odors kept, nothing renormalized) applied to the somata parts read once; items 2 to 4 on the somata so read

the realism flag's interval: the response rate ρ (Spearman over the 16 odors) of the shuffled matrix's APL-on read on P3 against the per-odor response fractions of resampled control recordings (each recording's KCs above the bands' noise criterion), N_BOOT draws with replacement, seed BOOT_SEED
holds: no simulation, no model run, no olfsysm change, nothing fitted, searched or chosen
no held-out panel enters a fit; nothing is chosen from E138's readings of validation2
